## What it is

A .NET Aspire–orchestrated **microservices e‑commerce reference app** (the eShop reference application), 19 projects on `net10.0` (plus MAUI TFMs), analyzed from `eShop.slnx`. The style detector rates it "Microservices, high confidence — Aspire orchestration of 9 runnable services", with Minimal APIs + Controllers, MediatR CQRS, EF Core/Postgres, FluentValidation and DDD aggregates (`Buyer`, `Order`).

## The composition root

`src/eShop.AppHost` is the Aspire AppHost — the thing you actually F5. It references and starts **nine** project resources (line numbers are the `AddProject` calls in `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs`):

| Process | Kind | Started at |
|---|---|---|
| Identity.API | Duende IdentityServer web app (MVC controllers) | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:23` |
| Basket.API | gRPC service | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:30` |
| Catalog.API | Minimal-API Web API (EF Core + pgvector) | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:36` |
| Ordering.API | Web API (MediatR/CQRS, DDD) | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:40` |
| OrderProcessor | Worker service | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:46` |
| PaymentProcessor | Worker service | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:51` |
| Webhooks.API | Web API | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:54` |
| WebhookClient | Blazor UI | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:65` |
| WebApp | Blazor storefront (+ YARP) | `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:69` |

Every one of these also references `eShop.ServiceDefaults` (`AddServiceDefaults` in `src/eShop.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs`) for OpenTelemetry, health checks and service discovery.

**Not** started by the AppHost: `ClientApp` (.NET MAUI) and `HybridApp` (MAUI + Blazor hybrid) are separately-launched client apps — the AppHost has no dependency edge to either; `ClientApp` even has its own solution `src/ClientApp/ClientApp.sln`. The remaining projects (`EventBus`, `EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`, `Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents`, `eShop.ServiceDefaults`) are libraries, not processes.

## Backing resources the AppHost also brings up

- **PostgreSQL** databases: `catalogdb` (`src/Catalog.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:15`), `orderingdb` (`src/Ordering.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:17`, also consumed by OrderProcessor at `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:13`); Identity.API and Webhooks.API have their own EF contexts (`src/Identity.API/Data/ApplicationDbContext.cs`, `src/Webhooks.API/Infrastructure/WebhooksContext.cs`) — I did not verify their Aspire resource names.
- **Redis** (`redis`) for the basket: `src/Basket.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:14`, backing `RedisBasketRepository`.
- **RabbitMQ** (`eventbus`): `AddRabbitMqEventBus("eventbus")` in `src/Basket.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:18`, `src/Catalog.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:31`, `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:10`.
- **AI backend, optional**: either Ollama as a container with `embedding`/`chat` models (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:AddOllama`, uses `all-minilm` and `llama3.1`) or OpenAI/Azure OpenAI connection strings `textEmbeddingModel`/`chatModel` (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:AddOpenAI`); Catalog picks between them at `src/Catalog.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:38-46`.
- The AppHost also injects `ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true` into every project resource (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:22-46`).

## Entry points inside those processes (109 total)

- **43 HTTP endpoints** — Catalog minimal APIs (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:21-107`), Ordering (`POST /api/orders/`, `PUT /api/orders/cancel|ship`, `POST /api/orders/draft`), Webhooks (`src/Webhooks.API/Apis/WebHooksApi.cs`), Identity MVC controllers (`src/Identity.API/Quickstart/...`).
- **3 gRPC methods** — `Basket.GetBasket/UpdateBasket/DeleteBasket` (`src/Basket.API/Grpc/BasketService.cs:8`).
- **13 RabbitMQ message consumers** — e.g. `OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler` in Basket.API, `OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler` in PaymentProcessor, `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEventHandler` in Webhooks.API.
- **1 hosted background service** — `GracePeriodManagerService`, registered at `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:18`; it is what makes OrderProcessor a process rather than a library.
- **7 MediatR domain-event handlers** in `src/Ordering.API/Application/DomainEventHandlers/`, behind the pipeline `LoggingBehavior → TransactionBehavior → ValidatorBehavior`.
- **42 UI entries** — Blazor routes in WebApp (`/cart`, `/checkout`, `/user/orders`) and WebhookClient (`/add-webhook`, `/login`), plus MAUI `[RelayCommand]` view-model entries in ClientApp and Razor pages in HybridApp.

## How the processes talk

WebApp → Basket.API over gRPC (`src/WebApp/Services/BasketService.cs:7`), WebApp → Catalog.API / Ordering.API over HTTP (`src/WebApp/Extensions/Extensions.cs:34,38`), WebhookClient → Webhooks.API (`src/WebhookClient/Extensions/Extensions.cs:19`), and everything else via 13 RabbitMQ integration events (Ordering.API ↔ Catalog.API, Ordering.API → PaymentProcessor, OrderProcessor → Ordering.API, Catalog/Ordering → Webhooks.API).

## Caveat

I could not open `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` as text with the tools available; the nine project registrations and their line numbers come from the dependency-graph provenance recorded for that file, and the resource names (`redis`, `eventbus`, `catalogdb`, `orderingdb`) come from the consuming services' own registration code cited above. The exact set of container resources declared in `Program.cs` (e.g. whether a standalone YARP reverse-proxy resource is added — `Aspire.Hosting.Yarp` is imported at `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:3`) is therefore inferred rather than read directly.
